page_title: NIC 0-2 LYO | Nice v Lyon 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Yellow card. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+3' Jeremie Boga (Nice) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.
89' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
89' Substitution. Thiago Almada will be replaced by Jordan Veretout (Lyon).

89' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
84' Here is a change. Moise Bombito is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ali Abdi (Nice) comes onto the pitch so that Melvin Bard can be given a rest.
83' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top left corner. Thiago Almada provided an assist for the goal.
81' The ball is out of play. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner.

81' Evann Guessand (Nice) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Lucas Perri pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball is out of play and Nice manage to earn a corner.
78' 0 - 1 Goal! Rayan Cherki (Lyon) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Thiago Almada inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
77' Substitution. Gaetan Laborde did his best and is replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
77' That's the end of the game for Hicham Boudaoui, who is replaced by Pablo Rosario (Nice).
77' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Nemanja Matic will be replaced by Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) is coming onto the pitch as Alexandre Lacazette cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Good clearance! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.

73' Thiago Almada (Lyon) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time low shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Marcin Bulka denies him.
72' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
69' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle as Sofiane Diop (Nice) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
69' Half-chance! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) plays a pass into the box, but Marcin Bulka reacts well to snuff out the attack.
68' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
66' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Mohamed-Ali Cho and he is replaced by Sofiane Diop (Nice).
66' The substitution has been made. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) has replaced Malick Fofana.
64' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
61' Evann Guessand (Nice) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
59' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
58' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
57' The ball goes out for a corner. Nice can continue in their attacking effort.

56' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper. Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
54' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) but poses no threat.
53' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner but it's cleared.

53' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Nice will have a corner.
51' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Evann Guessand (Nice) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Benoit Bastien who sees an offensive foul.
48' Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.

48' That didn't go as planned! Thiago Almada (Lyon) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Marcin Bulka, who easily kept it out.
46' Paulo Fonseca makes a half-time substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles comes on in place of Sael Kumbedi (Lyon).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
42' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Nice have a free kick.
41' Dante (Nice) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Benoit Bastien signals.
38' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Jonathan Clauss (Nice), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
37' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) sends a long ball in, but Marcin Bulka comfortably gathers the ball.
34' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
29' The corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is intercepted by Lucas Perri.
29' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
26' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Thiago Almada (Lyon) takes it short.
24' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
23' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
21' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
19' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

19' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Lucas Perri, who pulls off a stunning save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nice.
17' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Evann Guessand (Nice) brings an opponent down and Benoit Bastien interrupts the game.
12' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
5' Now Nice have a corner.
5' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
4' What was Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
1' The first half has just begun.
Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is the one who receives a yellow card.
Nice will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Benoit Bastien.
